edits.old: Then the system reads no case and writes no access-log entry
edits.new:
Then the system reads no case and writes no access-log entry

  Scenario: AC13 The service keeps the rules of section 8 on the page and the export (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns the page size limits, the export row limit and the ageing fields for the cases in scope
    When the manager reads the list and chooses Extract
    Then every fact comes through the owner contract and the limits are read from the rwb-case parameter rows at the version in force
    Then the page and the export write no business row, publish no event, start no workflow and create no Schedule; the only write is one access-log entry of the export
    Then the extract is a file made on request and no data-lake file is written
    Then with the flag rwb.casewf.case-list-ageing off the breached parameter is ignored and the case-side columns are kept
    Then the composed page and the P3 ageing contract give the same age and service level state for the same case

  Scenario: AC14 The list and the export answer 401, 403 and 404 as their contract allows (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-access contract mock returns no authenticated caller for the request
    When the caller requests the list
    Then the response is 401 with message Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P2-E2033-APP-AC14) and the system reads no case
    Given the rwb-access contract mock returns role "RW-REFADM" without the Case record right
    When the caller requests the export
    Then the response is 403 with message MSG-P4-002 and the system reads no case and writes no access-log entry
    When the caller requests a path that the service does not provide
    Then the response is 404 with message Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P2-E2033-APP-AC14)

  Scenario: AC15 A consumed call that fails or does not answer returns no list and no file (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock does not answer the case read
    When the manager requests the list
    Then the response is an error with message Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P2-E2033-APP-AC15) and no case is returned
    Given the rwb-access contract mock does not answer the authorise call
    When the manager chooses Extract
    Then the system produces no file and writes no access-log entry
